Load penetration test on RS soil at relative density approx 0.96; apparatus: LPT fixture; loading: static penetration. Recorded: load vs penetration. One of 2 tests drawn from the same figures.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 33 of the 34 points, and the rest were settled against the scan. Student reviewers have looked at 12 of the 34 points on the scan; two reviewers confirmed 2 of them (see the provenance page). The test setup is incomplete: unit weight, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

![load against penetration, SI units, this test in red and the other tests printed in Fig. 2-44 in gray. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-lpt-064a.png){.lightbox}

Peak load 8088 N at 110.21 mm penetration; 8075 N at 110.36 mm, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-lpt-064a/observations.csv) (34 points: 0 plotted symbols, 30 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: load in N against penetration in m; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-lpt-064a/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 538 micrometers in penetration, 38.45 N in load (0.5 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 33 of the 34 points; the other 1 was settled against the scan (read by one reader and verified by the other, or decided between two readings). [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-f2-44).
